author: Vieillot, 1817
status: 길잃은새, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 기록을 검토하는 중
habitat: 바닷가 섬 마을, 해안 공원, 항구 도시

months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이다(2010년 5월 7일~9월 25일 문갑도, 2023년 4월 27일~6월 5일 울산, 2025년 6월 강원).

summary: 2010년 5월 인천 옹진군 문갑도에서 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 이 개체는 9월 하순까지 섬에 머물렀고 큰 뱃길과 인천항이 가까워 배를 타고 왔을 것으로 본다. 2023년 4~6월에는 울산 대왕암공원 일대에 한 마리가 머물렀다. 원래 인도아대륙과 그 둘레의 도시와 마을에 붙어 사는 텃새로, 배를 타고 옮겨 가 세계 여러 항구 도시로 퍼졌다. 사람이 버린 음식 찌꺼기를 비롯해 가리지 않고 먹는다.

points.en: black forehead, crown, face and throat
grey collar over the nape, neck, upper mantle and breast
rest of the plumage black: back, wings and belly

art.subject: House Crow (Corvus splendens), adult (sexes alike): forehead, crown, face and throat glossy black, forming a black cap and bib; a broad grey collar, pale grey to dusky grey, covering the nape, the sides of the neck, the upper mantle and the breast; the rest of the back, wings, tail and belly black with a slight purple-green gloss. Black, fairly stout bill with an arched upper ridge; dark brown eye; black legs and feet.
art.pose: perched on a shoreline rock, side view, alert
art.scene: Korean rocky seashore in spring with seaweed-covered rocks and a calm sea; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a shoreline rock, alert: slim, rather small crow, black forehead, crown, face and throat, grey collar over the nape, neck, upper mantle and breast, black back, wings, belly and tail, long, slightly arched black bill, black legs

adult, three-quarter front view standing on the ground: black cap and black throat framed by the grey collar, grey breast meeting the black belly, slim build, long slightly arched black bill, black legs
art.build: Slim, medium-sized crow, noticeably smaller and lankier than the Carrion and Large-billed Crows and larger than the Daurian Jackdaw; fairly high-crowned head. Bill black, fairly large and stout, arched along the top. Legs black, fairly long. Tail medium, slightly rounded. In flight the wings are rather narrow with fingered tips. Bold and noisy, walking and hopping on the ground.
avoid: Do not paint a white collar and white belly; that pied pattern belongs to the Daurian Jackdaw (Coloeus dauuricus).
Do not give it a pale iris; the eye is dark.
Do not let the grey reach the forehead, crown or throat; these are black.
Do not make it all black like a Carrion Crow or as bulky as a Large-billed Crow.
